notes.title: Update 1.0.6.0
notes.notes: Fixed some minor bugs, added Vietnamese and Italian language

notes.title: Update 1.0.5.0 - Custom colors
notes.notes:
You can now create your own color theme. Just choose 'Custom' color theme in options and go to 'Colors' section to set whatever you like.

You can also share themes with each other by Copy/Paste encoded strings like this [b]b6rz8rdws4HcfuS2tLRQ8+zbsG9qGPp0xOjqkYXY//XYFBMRNzIyAA=[/b]

notes.title: Update 1.0.4.0
notes.notes:
Fix: "Square town" achievement didn't work
Added Romanian localization
Added Spanish localization
Added Korean localization

notes.title: 4 new languages added
notes.notes: Thanks to those who volunteered the game is now also available in Czech, German, Polish and Swedish!

notes.title: Dark mode added
notes.notes: A new optional color theme is added for those who prefer nocturnal city building

notes.title: Tile Cities released!
notes.notes: This game's development took place in Ukraine during war. Working on it helped me keep going through some of the worst moments of my life. I hope it will bring you some peace.
